title: No mercado
en: Buying fish and vegetables at the morning market.

paragraphs.pt: Todas as manhãs, o mercado de Peniche abre às sete. Há bancas de fruta, legumes, pão e, claro, muito peixe fresco.
paragraphs.en: Every morning, the Peniche market opens at seven. There are stalls with fruit, vegetables, bread and, of course, lots of fresh fish.

paragraphs.pt: A Dona Rosa vende peixe há trinta anos. Hoje tem sardinhas, carapaus e polvo. — Bom dia! Quanto custam as sardinhas? — Custam seis euros o quilo. — Então quero meio quilo, por favor.
paragraphs.en: Dona Rosa has sold fish for thirty years. Today she has sardines, horse mackerel and octopus. “Good morning! How much are the sardines?” “Six euros a kilo.” “Then I'd like half a kilo, please.”

paragraphs.pt: Depois do peixe, compro tomates, cebolas e uma alface. No fim, pago tudo e vou para casa. O almoço de hoje vai ser sardinhas assadas com salada.
paragraphs.en: After the fish, I buy tomatoes, onions and a lettuce. At the end I pay for everything and go home. Today's lunch is going to be grilled sardines with salad.

questions.q: How long has Dona Rosa sold fish?
How much do the sardines cost?
How many sardines do you buy?

glossary.dona: Mrs (polite title before a first name)
glossary.quanto: how much (quanto custam? = how much are they?)
glossary.ser: to be (vai ser = is going to be)

notes.en: for thirty years (and still now). Há + time + present tense: Moro aqui há dois anos = I've lived here for two years.
How much are they? Custa for one thing, custam for several.
